stem: A targeting laser line is $y = 2x$. A calibration sensor is at $A(5, 0)$. The receiver $B$ is the exact symmetric reflection of $A$ across the laser line. Work out $B$ and tap it on the grid.
solution: Let $B=(s,t)$. The line has gradient 2, so $AB$ has gradient $-\frac12$: $s+2t-5=0$.

hints.text: Check which of your two numbers is s (across) and which is t (up).
Check the signs when you solve the two equations.
AB must be perpendicular to the line, and the midpoint of AB must lie on it.
